units.source_text: 不過，我的這種怯弱絕不是狡猾，而是因為我不能理解女人這些不可思議的現象：

en.t: Still, this timidity of mine was not cunning at all; it was because I could not understand these mysterious phenomena in women:

units.source_text: 女人不會讓前一天晚上的床笫之歡，與翌日早晨起床後之間發生蛛絲馬跡的關聯，

en.t: women allow not the slightest trace of connection between the pleasures of bed the night before and the morning after they get up,

units.source_text: 她們彷彿忘卻了一切，徹底切斷這兩個世界而活著。

en.t: as if they have forgotten everything, they live by cutting those two worlds completely apart.

units.source_text: 十一月末，我與堀木在神田的攤鋪喝廉價酒，

en.t: At the end of November, I was drinking cheap liquor with Horiki at a stall in Kanda,

units.source_text: 離開那家攤鋪後，這位狐朋狗友建議再找一家繼續喝，

en.t: and after we left that stall, this bad companion proposed finding another place to keep drinking,

units.source_text: 口袋裡的銀子明明都花光了，可他還是吵嚷著喝、喝、喝。

en.t: even though the money in our pockets was clearly all gone, he still clamored to drink, drink, drink.

units.source_text: 那時，我也喝高了，酒勁壯膽，說道：「好吧，

en.t: By then I was drunk too, and the liquor had given me courage, so I said, "All right,

units.source_text: 既然這樣，那我就帶你去夢之國吧。

en.t: in that case, I will take you to the land of dreams.
